name: Calle Elena south · hedge beds on the east side of the lane
about: Kerbed hedge beds between the Elena south lane tiles and the patio wall and house front on its east side (Dave, 17-18 November 2026). Same structure and planting as data/cervantes_lane_edges.json, drawn by src/cervantes-lane-edges.ts in this lane's own frame: s metres along the Elena south centreline from the Cervantes junction, o metres off it, positive to the west.

planters.name: Elena south · hedge bed in front of the corner patio wall
planters.basis: IMG_2358 and IMG_2367 look down on a clipped hedge about 1.2 m high in a bed between the lane tiles and the white patio wall of the corner house (elena-south-mouth-patio-wall, bougainvillea trained over it), with the lamp post standing in the bed; ELENA-ROOF-2026-11-17 shows it along the left of the lane. Cast through the solved roof camera, the tile edge is 0.6-0.9 m east of the centreline and the hedge's face 1.0-1.2 m; the bed runs from the lane edge to the wall face. Ends and kerb height estimated. 18 November structure review: both solved roof cameras put the lane's tile edge at about 1.0 m east of the centreline, so the bed starts there (first built from 0.65 m, over photographed paving); the hedge fills the narrow bed and bulges over it in the photos.

planters.name: Elena south · hedge bed along the corner house
planters.basis: The same clipped hedge continues past the house corner along its lane-side wall (IMG_2358, IMG_2367, IMG_2330), between the lane tiles and the registry house face 1.4 m east of the centreline. South of 9.9 m the house fronts come within 0.15-0.4 m of the lane edge and the planting there is not built (discrepancy elena-south-east-beds). 18 November structure review: both solved roof cameras put the lane's tile edge at about 1.0 m east of the centreline, so the bed starts there (first built from 0.65 m, over photographed paving); the hedge fills the narrow bed and bulges over it in the photos.
